findings.summary: R1 milestone mapping includes M2 (Parallel Lane Execution) but R1 is an intake-level requirement that should only gate M1 (Intake & Work Plan Compilation). M2 depends on M1 completion, so R1 is implicitly satisfied before M2 begins.

evidence.note: R1 mapped to both M1 and M2
M1 exit criteria includes AT1 which validates R1
evidence.quote: All three input artifacts pass schema validation (AT2, AT3, AT1).

evidence.note: M2 depends on M1, so R1 is already satisfied

findings.summary: R2 milestone mapping includes M2 (Parallel Lane Execution) but R2 is an intake-level requirement enforced before code-generation begins. M2 depends on M1 where repo_context.json validation occurs. The mapping should be M1 only.

evidence.note: R2 mapped to both M1 and M2
R2 requires repo_context.json before any code-generation stage begins
evidence.quote: repo_context.json SHALL be required before any code-generation stage begins

evidence.note: M1 exit criteria validates repo_context.json via AT2
evidence.quote: All three input artifacts pass schema validation (AT2, AT3, AT1).
